g.text: Components are written once; the look comes from tokens

g.data-qualified-name: 1. Token values .the only place looks differ.
g.text: 1. Token values (the only place looks differ)

g.data-qualified-name: 1. Token values .the only place looks differ..Base
1. Token values .the only place looks differ..Theme

g.text: never ask which site they are on
Example: <Input/> in the public form and in the coach login
is the same code. On www it reads cream + navy border;
under data-theme="portal" the same variables resolve
to white + #b9c6da. Nothing is written twice.
colour, border, font, size, case, shadow, underline
different shape or markup on both sites
-> a documented variant prop on the shared component
Reading portal-theme.css = the full list of differences.
